title: Vtg 1985 Disney PINOCCHIO Black Diamond Padded VHS Video Cassette Tape
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1985 Disney Pinocchio Black Diamond padded VHS video cassette tape featuring the classic animated film "Walt Disney's Pinocchio." This G-rated VHS tape is in English language and belongs to the Animation & Anime genre. Produced by Walt Disney Home Video, this collectible item allows viewers to enjoy the timeless story of Pinocchio in the comfort of their own home on a nostalgic VHS format.
